mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, serial_number, purchaser, user_id, last_edit_user_id, last_edit_time
mapper.select:
select cw.*, u1.name as user_name, u2.name as last_edit_user_name from contract_waste AS cw left join sys_user u1 on cw.user_id = u1.id left join sys_user u2 on cw.last_edit_user_id = u2.id where cw.bool_delete_enum = 0
and cw.serial_number like concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
and cw.purchaser like concat('%',#{purchaser},'%')
and u1.name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')

SELECT temp.*, ROUND( temp.collection_amount / temp.total_amount, 4 ) AS collection_rate, ROUND( temp.invoice_amount / temp.total_amount, 4 ) AS invoice_rate FROM (SELECT ws.contract_waste_id, cw.serial_number, cw.purchaser, ws.branch_company_id, bc.`name` AS branch_company_name,
(SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM wms_waste_sale WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND contract_waste_id = ws.contract_waste_id AND branch_company_id = ws.branch_company_id AND audit_status_enum = 2) total_amount,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(collection_amount), 0) FROM contract_collection WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND type = 2 AND contract_waste_id = ws.contract_waste_id AND collection_unit_id = ws.branch_company_id AND audit_status = 2) collection_amount,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(invoice_amount), 0) FROM contract_invoice WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND type = 2 AND contract_waste_id = ws.contract_waste_id AND invoice_unit_id = ws.branch_company_id AND audit_status = 2) invoice_amount,
(SELECT COUNT(id) FROM contract_collection WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND type = 2 AND contract_waste_id = ws.contract_waste_id AND collection_unit_id = ws.branch_company_id AND audit_status = 1) un_check_collection_count,
(SELECT COUNT(id) FROM contract_invoice WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND type = 2 AND contract_waste_id = ws.contract_waste_id AND invoice_unit_id = ws.branch_company_id AND audit_status = 1) un_check_invoice_count FROM wms_waste_sale AS ws LEFT JOIN wms_waste_sale_detail AS wsd ON ws.id = wsd.waste_sale_id LEFT JOIN contract_waste AS cw ON ws.contract_waste_id = cw.id LEFT JOIN sys_branch_company AS bc ON ws.branch_company_id = bc.id WHERE ws.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ws.audit_status_enum = 2 AND wsd.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND DATE(ws.sale_date) >= DATE(#{startDate})
AND DATE(ws.sale_date) <= DATE(#{endDate})
AND ws.contract_waste_id = #{contractWasteId}
AND ws.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId}
AND wsd.waste_classification_id = #{wasteClassificationId}
GROUP BY ws.contract_waste_id, ws.branch_company_id ) AS temp ORDER BY temp.contract_waste_id, temp.branch_company_id
